title: Remove the OneDrive sync app (Store package Microsoft.OneDriveSync)
description: Removes the Microsoft Store OneDrive sync package (Microsoft.OneDriveSync) for the current user. User files, the classic (non-Store) OneDrive installer and account data are not touched. On undo the package is re-registered from its install location when the files are still on disk; if they are gone, the post-undo verification reports honestly that restoration was not possible.
